The review is done and the verdict is **pass**: the Refine page now shows what the ✦ chat heard, and the proof script passes on the phone sheet, the desktop chat and the Refine page. The chat bubble ordering had already been merged earlier.

⚠️ One gap is worth a look: when a dictated line gets corrected, the chat shows the corrected words but the Refine page keeps the old ones (`VoiceFollow.js:34`), so the two can disagree.

The other notes are smaller:
- **Slow updates:** the Refine page checks for new lines every couple of seconds instead of getting them as a stream, so text can take a few seconds to appear.
- **No clean-up:** the follower is never stopped when the demo goes away.
- **Proof:** it replays a saved session instead of one live dictation, and a real phone won't reach a desktop Refine tab.
- **Missing hash:** `next.md` still needs the commit hash for the Refine section once it merges.

Full report: [review.md](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/bubble-order/review.md)
